verses.text: Whoever lives in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
I will say about the LORD, "He is my safe place and my fortress, my God, whom I trust."
He will save you from the hunter's trap and from deadly disease.
He will cover you with his feathers. You will find safety under his wings. His faithfulness will be your shield and your wall.
You will not be afraid of the terrors of the night, or the arrow that flies by day,
or the disease that moves in the dark, or the disaster that destroys at noon.
A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.
You will only watch with your eyes and see the wicked punished.
Because you have made the LORD your safe place, and the Most High your home,
no harm will come to you. No disaster will come near your tent.
He will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
They will lift you up in their hands so you will not hit your foot against a stone.
You will walk on lions and cobras. You will trample young lions and snakes.
The LORD says, "Because he loves me, I will rescue him. I will protect him, because he knows my name.
When he calls to me, I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will rescue him and honour him.
I will satisfy him with a long life and show him how I save."
